page.overview:
Who is Cruise Kaiju?

Invincible (attempted victim) Anissa (killer)

The Cruise Kaiju is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting in Season 2.

The Kaiju was a monstrous creature from the second age of existence. It attacked a cruise ship carrying numerous tourists, attempting to crush and devour it. Its rampage was brought to an abrupt end when Anissa intervened and killed it with a single, decisive blow.

The Cruise Kaiju is a massive, serpentine leviathan with a menacing, alien presence. Its dull olive-green body is covered in thick, segmented armor, while its reddish-orange underbelly is disturbingly organic. Its hammerhead-like, eyeless face is crowned with jagged ridges and filled with writhing tentacle-like tongues.
